release_notes: Player fixes and control: Player 8/9 moved to the live videasy domain (black screen fixed) and embeds are sandboxed so ad pop-ups can no longer open Chrome. Settings > Player now switches individual players on/off, extraction stops as soon as a playable link is found, the app no longer hops players by itself, and TV show pages keep the player and season/episode controls within reach on phone, tablet, laptop and TV. MovieIN playback now relays through the fixed on-device engine route.
